scope: Two full HiChat web clients against isolated local API and LiveKit

environment.media: Local LiveKit 1.8.4, loopback-only ports, synthetic accounts
environment.client_source: 6d136901 plus concurrent uncommitted audio pipeline changes; not an immutable release test

observed: Both separate-origin full clients signed in with different synthetic human accounts and explicitly joined the same group call through UI.
User handled each origin's browser-owned microphone permission prompt. No browser permission bypass was used.
Both identities reached participant-active state and each published audio/opus with trackInfo.encryption GCM in local SFU logs.
Connected controls appeared in both clients. Friends navigation retained the app-level group call panel.

Call admission repeatedly returned to connecting and SFU logs showed multiple distinct participant sessions for each identity without explicit leave/join. Connection continuity is defective and is being investigated.
Both clients explicitly left through the persistent panel after reproduction. First client's panel absence was checked. Test microphone capture is no longer intentionally running.

visual.findings: Persistent panel renders, but raw camera/disconnect localization labels and compact default-looking controls remain visual gaps. Screenshot is not full visual acceptance.

not_proven: Peer-audible output or successful receiver GCM decryption
Stable long call, navigation continuity, rekey continuity
Physical device removal/recovery, Windows packaged runtime
YouTube music playback or production readiness

follow_up_diagnosis.method: Temporary DEV-only bounded numeric lifecycle diagnostics, removed before final source commit; no credentials or media content logged.
evidence: SFU participant-closing reason was CLIENT_REQUEST_LEAVE, followed by immediate new sessions. ICE failure was not established.
Before frontend write freeze, admission cleanup was followed by new provider and worker identities with unchanged scope and token owner. Concurrent Vite HMR is a confounding variable.

During frontend write freeze and Friends navigation, the same numeric Room54/provider55/worker56 remained connected through repeated observations. No new admission_create or cleanup occurred in that interval.
Same-Room admission key-check/ready events continued with unchanged key scope; their trigger still needs investigation. This is not proof of a production reconnect defect.
The diagnostic call was explicitly left through UI and panel absence was verified.
follow_up_diagnosis.conclusion: Initial production-defect classification was premature. Reproduce from a frozen or immutable client build before prescribing a runtime fix; peer-audible media acceptance remains open.

observed: Both clients reached connected controls. First client's initial key installation and exact worker acknowledgement completed.

First client retained the same Room4/provider2/worker3. SDK reconnecting/reconnected occurred at approximately35/38 and52/55 seconds after page start; each acknowledgement succeeded and no admission cleanup/fatal/key-timeout occurred in this observation.
Before this instrumentation, first client receiver reported3 audio RTP packets but0 total received audio samples/energy; publisher reported0 packets sent. No usable peer audio proven.
